ja: 自分が誘われてたなんて、知らなかったよ。
en: I didn't know I'd been invited.
alternatives: I had no idea I'd been invited.
I didn't realize I'd been invited.
point: 知った時点より前の「誘われた」は過去完了（受け身）

ja: パーティーは何時に始まるの？
en: What time does the party start?
alternatives: When does the party start?
What time is the party?
point: 三人称単数の疑問文は does を使い start は原形

ja: 彼、先月からずっと私の誘いを断ってるんだ。
en: He's been turning down my invitations since last month.
alternatives: He's been declining my invitations since last month.
He's been passing on my invitations since last month.
point: 「ずっと〜してる」は現在完了進行形＋since

ja: 忙しくなければ、君を食事に誘うのに。
en: I'd invite you out if I weren't busy.
alternatives: If I weren't busy, I'd invite you out.
If I weren't so busy, I'd invite you out.
point: 今の事実と逆の仮定は If I weren't と過去形

ja: 来られるかどうか、金曜までに教えて。
en: Tell me by Friday if you're coming.
alternatives: Let me know by Friday if you'll come.
Tell me by Friday whether you can come.
point: 「かどうか」は if / whether の名詞節。語順は平叙文

ja: 誘ってくれてありがと。でも今回は見送らせて。
en: Thanks for the invite, but I'll sit this one out.
alternatives: Thanks for asking, but I'm going to pass this time.
I appreciate the invite, but I'll skip this one.
point: sit ～ out は「今回は参加しない」の口語イディオム

ja: みんなが来られるか聞いてくれる？
en: Could you ask if everyone can make it?
alternatives: Could you ask everyone whether they can come?
Can you find out if everyone can come?
point: 間接疑問は if everyone can と平叙文の語順

ja: ずっと誘われるのを待ってたんだ。
en: I've been waiting to be invited.
alternatives: I've been hoping you'd invite me.
I've been waiting for an invitation.
I've been waiting for you to invite me.
point: 待ち続けている今までの期間は現在完了進行形

ja: 誰も行かなくても、私はライブに行くよ。
en: Even if nobody else goes, I'm going.
alternatives: I'll go even if nobody else does.
Even if no one goes, I'll go.
point: even if の後は、未来のことでも現在形

ja: 今夜の飲み会、誰が来るか教えて。
en: Tell me who's coming to drinks tonight.
alternatives: Let me know who's coming tonight.
Can you tell me who's coming tonight?
point: 「誰が来るか」は who's coming。Tell me の後は平叙文の語順

ja: 試合が終わったら、ご飯行こうよ。
en: Let's grab a bite when the game ends.
alternatives: Let's get something to eat after the game.
Let's go eat when the game's over.
point: 未来のことでも when 節は現在形 ends

ja: 佐藤さんちのバーベキュー、来る？
en: Are you coming to the Satos' barbecue?
alternatives: Are you going to the Satos' barbecue?
Will you come to the Satos' barbecue?
point: 決まった予定は進行形 Are you coming? で誘える

ja: みんなが行ける日を選んでもらえる？
en: Could you pick a day that works for everyone?
alternatives: Can you choose a date everyone can make?
Could you pick a day when everyone's free?
point: 「みんなが行ける日」は day を後ろから修飾する関係節

ja: 私たちと夕食でもどうかなと思ってたんですが。
en: I was wondering if you'd join us for dinner.
alternatives: I was wondering if you could join us for dinner.
I was hoping you'd join us for dinner.
point: 過去進行形 I was wondering if で控えめに誘う

ja: 今夜、一緒に夕食に行こうよ。
en: Let's go out for dinner tonight.
alternatives: Let's have dinner together tonight.
Let's go get dinner tonight.
point: 誘いは Let's＋動詞の原形で始める

ja: ごめん、土曜日は忙しいんだ。
en: Sorry, I'm busy on Saturday.
alternatives: Sorry, I'm not free on Saturday.
Sorry, I have plans on Saturday.
point: busy は形容詞なので be 動詞が必要

ja: 来週の土曜のほうがうちは都合いい。
en: Next Saturday is better for us.
alternatives: Next Saturday works better for us.
Next Saturday suits us better.
point: 日付を主語にして is better for us。We are better にしない

ja: 彼が飲み会の誘いを断ったなんて、信じられないよ。
en: I can't believe he turned down the invitation.
alternatives: I can't believe he declined the invitation.
I can't believe he passed on the invitation.
point: 「信じられない」の中身は that 節。that は省略できる

ja: 金曜空いてるか聞こうと思って電話したんだ。
en: I called to see if you're free Friday.
alternatives: I called to find out if you're free Friday.
I called to check if you're free on Friday.
point: 「〜か確かめる」は see if ＋平叙文の語順。to see で目的を表す

ja: パーティー、もう誘われた？
en: Have you been invited yet?
alternatives: Has anyone invited you yet?
Have you gotten an invite yet?
point: 「もう〜された？」は Have you been + 過去分詞 + yet

ja: 妹、BBQ来るけど遅れるかもって言ってた。
en: My sister said she'd come but might be late.
alternatives: My sister said she's coming but may be late.
My sister told me she'd come but might be late.
point: 「言ってた」に合わせて will ではなく would にする

ja: 彼女、ライブ後にラーメンを提案したよ。
en: She suggested getting ramen after the show.
alternatives: She suggested we get ramen after the show.
She proposed getting ramen after the show.
point: suggest の後は to 不定詞ではなく -ing か「we + 動詞の原形」

ja: 君がもっと早く誘ってたら、彼女も来られたのに。
en: If you'd invited her sooner, she could've come.
alternatives: If you'd asked her earlier, she could've made it.
She could've come if you'd invited her sooner.
point: 過去の仮定は had invited と could have come

ja: 送別会の誘い、断るしかなかったんだ。
en: I had to turn down the farewell invite.
alternatives: I had to decline the farewell party invite.
I had to say no to the farewell party.
point: 「誘いを断る」は turn down、「〜するしかなかった」は had to

ja: 彼女の誕生日にケーキ持っていくね。
en: I'll bring a cake for her birthday.
alternatives: I'll bring a cake to her birthday.
I'll bring a birthday cake for her.
point: 丸ごとのケーキは数えられるので a cake

ja: 同僚のランチの誘いを断ったんだ。
en: I turned down a coworker's lunch invite.
alternatives: I declined a coworker's lunch invitation.
I turned down my coworker's lunch invitation.
point: 「誘いを断る」は decline か turn down。invite は名詞でも使える

ja: 来られるか、ずっと返事を待ってるんだ。
en: I've been waiting to hear back from you.
alternatives: I've been waiting for your answer.
I've been waiting for you to reply.
point: 「ずっと待ってる」は have been + ing

ja: あの誘い、断らなきゃ今ごろキャンプ場にいたのに。
en: If I hadn't turned it down, I'd be camping now.
alternatives: If I hadn't said no, I'd be camping now.
If I'd said yes, I'd be camping right now.
point: 過去の条件は hadn't turned down、今の結果は I'd be

ja: 行けたらなあ。明日は早い便なんだ。
en: I wish I could, but my flight leaves early tomorrow.
alternatives: I wish I could go, but my flight's early tomorrow.
I wish I could join you, but my flight's early.
point: 今の叶わない願いは I wish I could。I wish I can とは言わない

ja: 彼女が知りたいのは、君が来られるかどうかだよ。
en: What she wants to know is whether you can come.
alternatives: She just wants to know if you can come.
What she's asking is whether you can make it.
point: 「〜なのは」は What で始め、かどうかは whether 節
